findings.section: Violations the review must rule on / Constraints
findings.summary: The rule 'only the two brief: "b" cases of internal/schema/schema_test.go may change' forbids the call-site edits V1 needs: the brief named has to reach the doctor's plan check, and runDoctor/runPreflight are called from existing tests. Also, 'the two cases' are really two literals covering 11 cases.
findings.evidence: runPreflight(e.build, e.repo, cmd) at internal/cli/doctor_copilot_test.go:48; runDoctor(e.build, e.repo) at internal/cli/doctor_second_review_test.go:13,24,38. In schema_test.go, the brief() helper at :174 feeds 10 cases and the 'fix full' literal at :183 is the 11th.
findings.fix: Allow mechanical call-site updates to existing tests that change no assertion. Or require V1 to keep the existing signatures, for example by passing the brief through a new function. Say 'the two literals (the brief() helper at :174 and the fix full case at :183)'.

findings.summary: The preflight refusal line is printed with the 'vloop: ' prefix. The worked example leaves the prefix out.
findings.evidence: internal/cli/root.go:97 prints fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "vloop: %s\n", ...). internal/cli/brief_review_test.go:75 pins "vloop: preflight failed — 2 problem(s), nothing has run". The B29 brief writes it with the prefix.
findings.fix: Write 'vloop: preflight failed — 1 problem(s), nothing has run' in the three V1 lines that expect exit 1 and in the planted case.

findings.summary: The contract does not say whether the revert runs when the plan or gate-review session times out or exits non-zero. Both cases halt in planSession and gateReviewRound right after the refs checks. If the revert runs after those halts, a halted session leaves its stray changes in the tree, and the re-run hits the clean-tree refusal.
findings.evidence: In internal/driver/plan.go:551-561 the timeout and non-zero exit halts come after the refs and git-config checks. internal/driver/gatereview.go:62 halts on timeout. The review guard reverts before it looks at the timeout (internal/driver/iterate.go:798-809).
findings.fix: State the order: refs and git-config checks first, then the revert and its warnings, then the timeout and exit-code halts, as in reviewRun. Pin one case: a plan session that changes README.md and exits 1 leaves README.md as on the base.

findings.summary: No document gains V1's rule. The precedent the brief cites (0a87d5a) documented the state/v1 rule in docs/domain/execution/plan.md. Only the V2 and V3 docs are listed.
findings.evidence: docs/domain/execution/plan.md:7 says 'vloop run never resumes a state/v1 plan — an unfinished one is refused, a complete one is replaced by the next brief's plan'. Nothing says the same of state/v2. `git show 0a87d5a --stat` lists plan.md.
findings.fix: Add a Docs bullet: plan.md:7 (or docs/domain/execution/run.md's preflight paragraph) says that a complete plan of another brief is not validated, by the run that names a different brief or by vloop doctor.

findings.summary: The brief says runPreflight 'knows the brief named'. It does not: its signature takes no brief. newRun resolves briefPath just before calling it.
findings.evidence: internal/cli/run.go:182 func runPreflight(b Build, root string, cmd *cobra.Command). briefPath is resolved at run.go:77-81 and runPreflight is called at :83.
findings.fix: Write 'runPreflight, called from newRun after briefPath is resolved; V1 passes the brief to it'. This ties into the first finding.

findings.summary: Unsure: 'no report the driver accepts today becomes invalid' has one edge case. A brief file named exactly '.loop-brief.md' passes the CLI's suffix check and gives the name '.loop-brief', which the new pattern rejects.
findings.evidence: internal/cli/brief_review.go:71 checks only strings.HasSuffix(rel, brief.Suffix). The pattern ^[^/\\]+\.loop-brief$ needs at least one character before '.loop-brief'.
findings.fix: Settle it by checking whether the brief's frontmatter or name rules already refuse such a file. If they do, say so; if not, write 'no report for a brief with a name'.

decisions: One brief for three issues: sound, because the files they touch are disjoint.
Only a complete state/v2 plan of another brief skips validation. vloop run with no brief counts as a resume and is still validated: consistent with the planner (plan.go:434).
The bare vloop doctor passes a complete state/v2 plan, naming the plan's brief field: agree.
The guard wraps each plan and gate-review session, not the commit: agree, because the base gates run in the working tree (acceptance.go baseGates).
The plan phase may write under .vloop/state/ and .vloop/tmp/, which is wider than S-4's list: acceptable, and the state guard is out of scope.
Revert and warn, not halt, on #111: the operator's decision. A revert that fails halts with exit 1 and is not gated.
brief-review/v1 is tightened in place, a stated exception to B29's rule that a published schema does not change: the operator's decision. See the '.loop-brief' edge case.
No patterns on the task fields of verdict/v1, proposal/v1 or gate-verdict/v2: agree.
checked: facts (doctor, run preflight, planner reset/resume, tree guard, gate review, schema and tests, kept brief reviews, docs sentences, domain IDs), consistency, rules, runnability against the go check
